accessibility.description: Developer-reported VoiceOver support gives every gem and obstacle a spoken label, with Board status and Special gems elements counting obstacles, ingredients and specials, and VoiceOver rotors for faster board navigation. Swap by selecting a gem and double-tapping a neighbour. Each move is summarised after it settles, including chain depth; hints name the exact pair to swap, and rejected moves explain why without spending a move. AppleVis players report it as very accessible.
